reviews.title: Paid for nothing
reviews.text: I purchased the yearly subscription to my loss In March of 2025. Was never able to access anything on the app other than the what comes for free. I reached through the app as well as through email, they were of no help, just kept asking for the same thing over and over even though it was sent, which was proof of purchase, and I sent a copy of my Apple Pay as well as my Apple Store showing my subscription. I really enjoyed this app and it has been a great resource for fasting. It saddens me that once again companies are taken advantage of stealing for the little people!! I shouldn’t be that shocked!! I do want to warn others that before you invest in this app  be warned that they do not honor your payments and/or purchases!! This app will help you along your journey and is great for that just don’t be fooled and spend money on a product you can’t use!!!

reviews.title: Very Helpful!
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for a few days now and I’m loving it. It suggested a 16:8 fasting/eating windows. The 16 hour fast is easy peasy. Having the timer really helps hold me accountable. The tips and encouraging quotes are really great as well. I’ve lost 2.5 pounds in just 3 days. If you want to try intermittent fasting I highly recommend this app

reviews.title: Purchase a different app
reviews.text: The concept is there, but the quality of the app is horrible. The chat function is super spotty, takes forever to load, and doesn’t show all of the comments. This should be a free app considering the quality! I wish I had purchased a different IM fasting app I had tried before this one. It is also very difficult to figure out how to change your fasting times if you mark it wrong on accident. Also, when I got a new phone I lost ALL of my fasting data. Overall, there are other apps that have much better function and features!

reviews.title: Hope lost
reviews.text: I was taken in by the initial introduction to the process but after subscribing for 3 months at $40, I felt so uninspired by the minimal substance. Granted, I take full responsibility for taking a chance with my money. But I was truly hoping for a more in depth program. Took a shot and missed on this one. But I do appreciate it working for some.

reviews.title: Not User Friendly
reviews.text: I’m 34 and a mom of a 10 year old, so I think I have a good grasp on technology, but I cannot figure this app out for the life of me. So far, all the app offers is IF tracking and information about IF. I would save your money, do some research online about IF, and use your phone to set reminders for when you’re fasting. I wish there was a 7 day free trial because I am now locked in for 3 months and have to pay $40.

reviews.title: Fasting For Women
reviews.text: This has been an extremely helpful tool in my weight loss journey for better health and well being.  I would highly recommend it to anyone who is seeking a healthy way to do intermittent fasting.  The coaches are accessible, responsive, and give great tips for staying on course.

reviews.title: I can’t access my subscription

reviews.title: Wonderful App and Customer Support
reviews.text: I’m thrilled with this fasting app. It’s very easy to use, and really helps to motivate me to stay on track. There are useful, healthy recipes for all different types of dietary needs, even vegan for me! There’s a chat room to help others and answer questions, plus a plethora of valuable information about fasting and health. I’ve used it now for about a month, love it! Will probably do some form of fasting for the rest of my life, feels fantastic!

reviews.title: Thank you Kate
reviews.text: I let Kate know of my concern's and she responded back in a timely manner. I just started this app and I appreciate that it offers support because I know I will have more questions. Thanks for caring 😊
